# Context:
A small software firm has four offices, numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4. Each of its offices has exactly one computer and exactly one printer. Each of these eight machines was bought in either 1987, 1988, or 1989. The eight machines were bought in a manner consistent with the following conditions: The computer in each office was bought either in an earlier year than or in the same year as the printer in that office. The computer in office 2 and the printer in office 1 were bought in the same year. The computer in office 3 and the printer in office 4 were bought in the same year. The computer in office 2 and the computer in office 3 were bought in different years. The computer in office 1 and the printer in office 3 were bought in 1988.

# Question:
If the computer in office 4 was bought in 1988, then which one of the following statements must be true?

# Options:
A) The printer in office 1 was bought in 1988.
B) The printer in office 1 was bought in 1989.
C) The computer in office 2 was bought in 1988.
D) The computer in office 3 was bought in 1987.
E) The printer in office 4 was bought in 1989.

from z3 import *

# Declarations
offices_sort = IntSort()
years_sort = IntSort()
machines_sort, (computer, printer) = EnumSort('machines', ['computer', 'printer'])
offices = [1, 2, 3, 4]
years = [1987, 1988, 1989]
machines = [computer, printer]
bought_in = Function('bought_in', offices_sort, machines_sort, years_sort)

# Pre_Conditions
pre_conditions = []
# The computer in each office was bought either in an earlier year than or in the same year as the printer in that office.
pre_conditions.append(And([bought_in(o, computer) <= bought_in(o, printer) for o in offices]))
# The computer in office 2 and the printer in office 1 were bought in the same year.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(2, computer) == bought_in(1, printer))
# The computer in office 3 and the printer in office 4 were bought in the same year.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(3, computer) == bought_in(4, printer))
# The computer in office 2 and the computer in office 3 were bought in different years.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(2, computer) != bought_in(3, computer))
# The computer in office 1 and the printer in office 3 were bought in 1988.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(1, computer) == 1988)
# The computer in office 1 and the printer in office 3 were bought in 1988.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(3, printer) == 1988)
# The computer in office 4 was bought in 1988.
pre_conditions.append(bought_in(4, computer) == 1988)
m1 = Const('m1', machines_sort)
pre_conditions.append(And([ForAll([m1], And(1987 <= bought_in(o0, m1), bought_in(o0, m1) <= 1989)) for o0 in offices]))

# Question: If the computer in office 4 was bought in 1988, then which one of the following statements must be true?
def is_sat(option_constraints):
    solver = Solver()
    solver.add(pre_conditions)
    solver.add(option_constraints)
    return solver.check() == sat

# A) The printer in office 1 was bought in 1988.
if is_sat(bought_in(1, printer) == 1988): print('(A)')
# B) The printer in office 1 was bought in 1989.
if is_sat(bought_in(1, printer) == 1989): print('(B)')

# D) The computer in office 3 was bought in 1987.
if is_sat(bought_in(3, computer) == 1987): print('(D)')
# E) The printer in office 4 was bought in 1989.

# Declarations
# Of the five Pohl children—Sara, Theo, Uma, Will, and Zoe—three are left-handed and two are right-handed. Each of the five children was born in a different one of seven calendar years, 1990 through 1996.
children_sort, (Sara, Theo, Uma, Will, Zoe) = EnumSort('children', ['Sara', 'Theo', 'Uma', 'Will', 'Zoe'])
handedness_sort, (left, right) = EnumSort('handedness', ['left', 'right'])
years_sort = IntSort()
children = [Sara, Theo, Uma, Will, Zoe]
handedness = [left, right]
years = [1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995, 1996]
handed = Function('handed', children_sort, handedness_sort)
born_in = Function('born_in', children_sort, years_sort)

# Pre_Conditions
pre_conditions = []
# three are left-handed
pre_conditions.append(Sum([handed(c) == left for c in children]) == 3)
# two are right-handed
pre_conditions.append(Sum([handed(c) == right for c in children]) == 2)
# No two left-handed children were born in consecutive years
c1 = Const('c1', children_sort)
c2 = Const('c2', children_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([c1, c2], Implies(And(handed(c1) == left, handed(c2) == left, c1 != c2), Abs(born_in(c1) - born_in(c2)) != 1)))
# No two right-handed children were born in consecutive years
c1 = Const('c1', children_sort)
c2 = Const('c2', children_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([c1, c2], Implies(And(handed(c1) == right, handed(c2) == right, c1 != c2), Abs(born_in(c1) - born_in(c2)) != 1)))
# Sara, who is left-handed, was born before Uma
pre_conditions.append(born_in(Sara) < born_in(Uma))
# Zoe was born before Theo
pre_conditions.append(born_in(Zoe) < born_in(Theo))
# Zoe was born before Will
pre_conditions.append(born_in(Zoe) < born_in(Will))
# A left-handed child was born in 1991
c = Const('c', children_sort)
pre_conditions.append(Exists([c], And(handed(c) == left, born_in(c) == 1991)))
# Uma, who is right-handed, was born in 1993
pre_conditions.append(born_in(Uma) == 1993)
# Sara is left-handed
pre_conditions.append(handed(Sara) == left)
# Uma is right-handed
pre_conditions.append(handed(Uma) == right)
# If Sara was born before Zoe was born
pre_conditions.append(born_in(Sara) < born_in(Zoe))
c0 = Const('c0', children_sort)
pre_conditions.append(ForAll([c0], And(1990 <= born_in(c0), born_in(c0) <= 1996)))

# Question: If Sara was born before Zoe was born, then which one of the following statements CANNOT be true?
def is_unsat(option_constraints):
    solver = Solver()
    solver.add(pre_conditions)
    solver.add(option_constraints)
    return solver.check() == unsat


# A) Will is left-handed.
if is_unsat(handed(Will) == left): print('(A)')
# B) Zoe is left-handed.
if is_unsat(handed(Zoe) == left): print('(B)')
# C) Theo was born after Will was born.
if is_unsat(born_in(Theo) > born_in(Will)): print('(C)')
# D) Uma was born after Zoe was born.
if is_unsat(born_in(Uma) > born_in(Zoe)): print('(D)')
c = Const('c', children_sort)
# E) No child was born in 1990.
if is_unsat(ForAll([c], born_in(c) != 1990)): print('(E)')
